title: aubi: delete reader CredentialStore duplicate; update 5 import sites
description:
## What
Delete crates/reader/src/store/credentials.rs (the duplicate CredentialStore) and update all 5 files that import from it to use stoa_auth::CredentialStore instead.

## Why
stoa-auth already contains the canonical, better-tested CredentialStore with #[derive(Debug)] and is_empty(). The reader's local copy is a strict subset that diverged in naming only.

## Files to update (5 total)

### Production code
1. crates/reader/src/store/server_stores.rs
   - Line 30: change 'use crate::store::credentials::CredentialStore;' → 'use stoa_auth::CredentialStore;'
   - No other changes needed (UserCredential already fixed by aubi.2)

### Test files (4)
2. crates/reader/tests/e2e_data_flow.rs
   - Change import of stoa_reader::store::credentials::CredentialStore → stoa_auth::CredentialStore
   - Change import of stoa_reader::config::UserCredential → stoa_auth::UserCredential (if imported separately)
3. crates/reader/tests/injection_provenance_e2e.rs — same pattern as above
4. crates/integration-tests/tests/two_process_harness.rs
   - Change import of stoa_reader::store::credentials::CredentialStore → stoa_auth::CredentialStore
5. crates/integration-tests/tests/nntp_conformance.rs — same pattern

## Algorithm
1. Read each of the 5 files at the cited lines.
2. Update the import lines as described.
3. Delete crates/reader/src/store/credentials.rs.
4. Remove 'pub mod credentials;' from crates/reader/src/store/mod.rs (if it exists there).
5. Run: cargo build --workspace 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?
6. Run: cargo test --workspace 2>&1 | tail -20; echo TEST_EXIT:$?
7. Run: cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -10
8. Run: cargo fmt --all -- --check 2>&1; echo FMT:$?
   If fmt fails, run cargo fmt --all and re-check.

## Defensive rules
- Read before editing — do not assume exact line numbers match research report.
- Do not edit any file outside the 5 listed.
- Do not change any logic — only import paths.
- The stoa-auth CredentialStore has is_empty() which the reader copy lacked. Any call to is_empty() on the reader copy was an error before — check for any such call in reader code.

## Acceptance
All workspace tests pass; credentials.rs deleted; no import of stoa_reader::store::credentials anywhere; cargo clippy -D warnings clean
